Latex or Pocketspring

Every Dreamwool bed is made to order in Christchurch. Choose the buoyant support of charcoal-infused natural latex, or the contouring give of individually wrapped pocket springs. Both are layered in pure South Island Merino and move with you as you sleep.

The science of Merino

Naturally handles the heat.

Merino comes from sheep that thrive through icy South Island winters and scorching summers. Inside your mattress, the same fibre draws humidity away and holds your ideal sleep temperature, so you're never too hot and never too cold.

Crafting luxury beds since 1934

The great New Zealand Merino bed company

In 1978, Edgar Henderson, an ex-farmer with a bad back, remembered the black wool singlets his shearers wore and how they kept them comfortable whatever the weather. That idea became Dreamwool's first woollen overlay.

Still in the Henderson family, we handcraft fewer than 500 Merino mattresses a year, each one made to order.
